body: Frontier language-model agents can now improve robots on their own: they write control code, test it, and keep what works as skills and memories for the next task. We introduce SEAR (Self-Evolving Agentic Robotics), a framework and benchmark built around two questions. Is the agent really learning, or just trying more often? And does what it learns still help on new tasks, in a new simulator, and on a real robot? The framework runs an agent in three modes: it writes code that becomes the policy (code-as-policy), acts live in the control loop (agent-as-policy), or works as a researcher that fine-tunes a vision-language-action model (auto-research). The benchmark adds controls that separate retained experience from repeated attempts, familiar tasks, privileged simulator state, larger budgets, and luck. Across seven frontier language models, 330 simulated and five physical tasks, and over four years of agent runtime, we highlight three findings. First, the learning curve of a robotic agent depends both on the overall time budget and the task difficulty relative to model capability. Harder tasks make longer sessions worthwhile; on easier tasks, re-rolling short attempts does just as well. Second, control code and shared routines transfer across tasks and simulators, while task-specific solutions do not. On a real robot, we observe a performance gap between agent-designed practice and novel human-designed scenes. Third, different models evolve more effectively in different ways. Some do best acting live, others writing code first. And a text-only model keeps pace with a comparable multimodal one: perception helps with error assessment, but agentic reasoning and tool use can matter more. We release the benchmark and codebase to support future research.
summaryZh: SEAR构建了一套旨在评测具身智能体自主进化能力的框架与评测基准，重点探究智能体是否真正学到可泛化能力还是仅靠重复试错。基准涵盖代码策略、在线控制与VLA微调三种模式，在7款前沿模型、330个仿真任务与真实机械臂环境中展开测试。实验发现控制代码能较好跨任务迁移，且纯文本模型借助强大推理与工具调用能达到媲美多模态模型的表现。

aiReview.reasonZh: 构建了评估大模型机器人自主进化与真假学习的基准SEAR，并在仿真和真机上进行了系统性长程验证。

glossary.explanationZh: 代码即策略，大模型通过直接生成可执行的控制代码来驱动机器人完成复杂动作。
视觉-语言-动作模型，直接将视觉图像与语言指令映射为底层机器人控制动作的多模态具身模型。
自进化智能体，能够自主编写代码、测试验证并保留有效经验作为记忆和技能的智能系统。
模拟器特权状态，指仿真环境中大模型可以获取但在真实世界无法直接获得的完整物理及物体信息。
